title: Mobile footer layout and interaction verified
summary: Responsive footer, expandable navigation and simulated newsletter success checked locally.

changes.detail: Verified mobile contact rows, newsletter panel, social touch targets and compact navigation while retaining desktop columns.

validation.name: Responsive layout
validation.detail: Footer has no internal horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768 or 1280px. Inspected mobile screenshot. Mobile disclosure navigation is hidden on desktop.

validation.name: Navigation and form
validation.detail: Pointer and keyboard expansion show links; keyboard collapse hides links. Mocked newsletter success disables email and removes submit button. No real subscription was sent. Initial automation used a terminal-corrupted accented selector; corrected to href and reran successfully.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No live newsletter delivery, physical-device or exhaustive screen-reader testing. No deployment.
